name: Subsistence
author: syyyn84@gmail.com
description: Subsistence dedicated server (Steam app 1362640). The dedicated server is Windows-only (UDK.exe / Unreal Engine 3), so this egg installs the Windows depot through SteamCMD and runs it under Wine + Xvfb. Allocate the game port (default 7777 UDP/TCP), a Steam query port (default 27015 UDP.) Official guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2201638184
startup: rm -f /home/container/UDKGame/Logs/Launch.log; xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1024x768x16' wine /home/container/Binaries/Win64/UDK.exe server coldmap1?steamsockets -log -FORCELOGFLUSH -Port={{SERVER_PORT}}   -ini:UDKEngine:OnlineSubsystemSteamworks.OnlineSubsystemSteamworks.QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} & UDK_PID=$!; tail -F /home/container/UDKGame/Logs/Launch.log --pid=$UDK_PID

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Subsistence Dedicated Server installer
# App ID 1362640 is Windows-only, so force the Windows depot and run it with Wine at runtime.

set -e

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Subsistence Dedicated Server (app 1362640, Windows via Wine)${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

if [[ -z "${STEAM_USER}" ]] || [[ -z "${STEAM_PASS}" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "anonymous" ]]; then
    echo -e "Using anonymous Steam login."
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "Steam user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD can fail if ownership/HOME is wrong during install
chown -R root:root /mnt || true
export HOME=/mnt/server
echo -e "${YELLOW}Downloading Windows dedicated server files (app ${SRCDS_APPID})...${NC}"
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +app_update 1007 +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so || true
cp -v /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so || true

# The Wine prefix is created by the runtime yolk on first start. Don't wipe it on reinstall.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/UDKGame/Config /mnt/server/UDKGame/Logs /mnt/server/UDKGame/SaveData

SETTINGS=/mnt/server/UDKGame/Config/UDKDedServerSettings.ini
if [ ! -f "${SETTINGS}" ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Seeding UDKDedServerSettings.ini${NC}"
    cat > "${SETTINGS}" << 'EOF'
[ColdGame.ColdDedServerSettings]
ProfileId=1
HuntersEnabled=true
HunterAttacks=0
Difficulty=normal
DaysPerYear=36
MonthOverride=-1
Password=
AdminPassword=changeme
ServerName=Pelican Subsistence Server
ServerDescription=A Subsistence dedicated server
HostedByName=Pelican
MaxPlayers=32
NumPlayerOfflineHoursBeforeBaseDecay=0
PvPDamage=true
PlayersCanDamagePlayerBases=true
OfflineBaseProtection=true
PlayersCanAccessEnemyPlayerBaseItems=true
Mods=
EOF
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/Binaries/Win64/UDK.exe ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}ERROR: Binaries/Win64/UDK.exe was not found after SteamCMD install.${NC}"
    echo -e "${RED}The Windows depot may have failed to download. Check the SteamCMD log above.${NC}"
    ls -la /mnt/server /mnt/server/Binaries || true
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "${GREEN}Installation completed.${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}First start initializes the Wine prefix and runs winetricks (${WINETRICKS_RUN}), which takes a few minutes.${NC}"

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password used to log in as admin. Join with ?password=THIS_VALUE or start steam.<uid>?password=THIS_VALUE

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: If 1, the Wine yolk entrypoint will run SteamCMD before each start.

variables.name: Base Decay Hours
variables.description: Real-world hours a team must be offline before their base starts decaying. 0 disables decay. Example: 96 = 4 days.

variables.name: Days Per Year
variables.description: In-game days per in-game year. Allowed: 12, 24, 36, 48, 60, 90, 120, 200, 365.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: easy / normal / hardcore

variables.name: Enemy Base Item Access
variables.description: If true, players can access enemy chests, refineries, etc. Does not affect doors/windows/hatches.

variables.name: Hosted By
variables.description: Host label shown in the in-game server list. Max 64 characters.

variables.name: Hunter Attacks
variables.description: 0 = normal attacks, 1 = revenge only, 2 = no attacks.

variables.name: Hunters Enabled
variables.description: Whether AI hunters spawn on the server.

variables.name: Join Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join. Leave blank for an open server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum player slots. Official range is 1-32.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Comma-separated workshop IDs and/or local mod UUIDs written to UDKDedServerSettings.ini. Example: 567890,81873EFT-F20C-56FE-BD9B-DAC37A0E2275. Leave blank for vanilla.

variables.name: Month Override
variables.description: -1 = use save file month. Otherwise 0-11 (Jan-Dec). Reset to -1 after the first launch.

variables.name: Offline Base Protection
variables.description: Protect bases while all members are offline (within BCU / range extender).

variables.name: Players Can Damage Bases
variables.description: If true, players can damage player-placed buildables.

variables.name: Profile Id
variables.description: Save slot on this instance. Must be 1-5.

variables.name: PvP Damage
variables.description: If true, players can damage other players.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Short description shown when a player clicks the server in the list. Max 256 characters.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the in-game dedicated server list. Max 64 characters.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Subsistence Dedicated Server Steam App ID.

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch
variables.description: Optional SteamCMD beta branch (for example experimental). Leave empty for the default public branch.

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port so the server appears in the in-game list. Allocate this UDP port on the server and set this value to match. Default 27015.

variables.name: SteamAppId
variables.description: Client/game App ID required by Steamworks on the dedicated server.

variables.name: WINDOWS_INSTALL
variables.description: Force SteamCMD to download the Windows dedicated server depot.

variables.name: WINEARCH
variables.description: Wine architecture. UDK.exe is 64-bit.

variables.name: WINEDEBUG
variables.description: Wine debug channel filter.

variables.name: WINETRICKS_RUN
variables.description: Winetricks verbs installed on first start by the Wine yolk. UE3 needs VC++ 2010/2019 and D3DX9.

variables.name: XVFB
variables.description: Enable the virtual framebuffer in the Wine yolk entrypoint.
